field_notes.chain_id: Cosmos SDK chain ID to pass to allorad and wallet software.
field_notes.deployed_version: allora-chain release tag documented as deployed on this network.
field_notes.emissions_namespace: Versioned emissions module namespace used in LCD/REST and gRPC query paths, e.g. <lcd>/emissions/v10/params.
field_notes.faucet: Testnet-only faucet for ALLO gas. Omitted on networks that have none.
field_notes.abci_version: Raw result.response.version returned by <rpc>abci_info when this file was last updated. allora-chain reports a build identifier here rather than a release tag; the scheduled drift check compares against this value.
